avoid: Heavy full-force oak sticks (use light wood or padded sticks)
children.game_version: 'Stick Tag Rally': Children form two lines and practice rhythmic light tapping games to musical cues, earning points for clean rhythm.

seniors.seated_version: Seated in chairs facing a partner, hold light foam or lightweight wood dowels and execute alternating front strikes on counts 1 and 2 without leg lifts.
seniors.standing_version: Perform stationary face-to-face stick taps without jumping or rapid spatial crossings.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to 85 BPM, limiting arm swing range to chest height.

learning_units.description: Basic 2/4 stick clash between derechero and izquierdero

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Firm grip on one or two wooden sticks, executing defensive blocks with the right arm or offensive strikes with the left arm.
movement_profile.footwork: Springy marching steps, directional passes, and single-leg lifts in 2/4 rhythm.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Opposed double lines, inner/outer rotating circles ('cadena'), or four-person quadrangles ('cuadras').
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Square to partner, stable core with dynamic torso rotation during crossing moves.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes ground strikes and high aerial leaps to clash sticks mid-air.
movement_profile.partnering: Non-contact body position with direct stick-to-stick engagement across opposing rows.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, alert athletic stance with knees slightly flexed to absorb leaps and rapid directional changes.

signature_moves.description: Dancers cross paths moving in opposite directions while striking sticks in passing.
signature_moves.name: pasada

signature_moves.description: A emblematic move striking sticks together beneath a raised leg.
signature_moves.name: bajocama

signature_moves.description: A rapid sequence of three heavy strikes alternating front, left, and front.
signature_moves.name: batacada

signature_moves.description: Two concentric closed loops rotating in opposite directions while striking sticks with each passing dancer.
signature_moves.name: cadena

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Driving, driving duple pulse with sharp accent on impact points.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Loose grip on sticks, uncoordinated swing timing, and leaning into partner's strike path.

music_profile.musical_form: Short, highly repetitive binary tunes lasting approximately one minute per dance section
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Straight fast binary duple pulse with prominent downbeat percussive stick strikes
music_profile.sound_description: Bright, piercing wind melodies driven by shawms or tabor pipes, punctuated by acoustic percussive clashing of solid oak sticks on every beat.

basic_steps: Stand in parallel double file facing partner with stick held upright in right hand
Step forward on count 1 in 2/4 meter while striking partner's stick at chest level
Execute pasada by stepping past partner to the right while striking sticks in passing
Perform bajocama by lifting left leg and striking sticks underneath the raised thigh
teaching.formation: Double row (file) of 8, 12, 16, 20, or 24 dancers facing each other
teaching.level_notes: Requires precise hand-eye coordination, firm wrist control, and rhythmic accuracy to avoid injury when clashing oak sticks.
